messages.subject: Web Services and Shiny
parts:
I'm interested in using web services to pass data into and out of a Shiny application to be hosted on a server.  I've seen various R packages (plumbr (rapier) and libraries (OpenCPU) that are supposed to enable this on the server side, but have never seen a comparison of the various tools and approaches that highlights capabilities, strengths, weaknesses, etc..  Is anyone familiar with such a comparison, or can anyone point to a person or a firm that has substantial experience in this area?
thank you-
MB

messages.subject: Re: Web Services and Shiny
parts: Can you talk more about the scenario you have in mind? Is the data supposed to be persisted? Is the data connected to any particular session? What happens if there are multiple Shiny processes per app (for scalability), does your data need to get into all of them at the same time?
